name: @dw/hud
description: The HUD: a Swift/AppKit app that `scripts/dw` builds on the user's Mac from these sources

scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'if [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && command -v swiftc >/dev/null 2>&1; then swiftc -typecheck *.swift; else echo "skipped: swiftc with AppKit is macOS only"; fi'
